frame.converter: Astropy SkyCoord Galactic to ICRS, heliocentric Cartesian

meaning: HII regions compiled by Hou & Han (2014) to outline the spiral arms: each at its photometric or trigonometric distance (Dist) where one is published, otherwise at the kinematic distance the authors computed from R0 = 8.3 kpc and a flat rotation curve (D8.3), with their near/far resolution. One dot per region; the table lists a row per observation.

appearance.note: Presentation only: the pink of ionised hydrogen, a shade deeper than the WISE layer.
appearance.emphasis: Arm tracer: young, massive star formation that outlines the spiral arms, drawn at full strength.

mapWeight.basis: Hou & Han (2014), Sect. 2.4 and Eq. 2: a weight for the kind of tracer, times 0.5/σ in each disc axis (1 when σ < 0.5 kpc) for a kinematic distance, with σ from a ±7 km/s velocity uncertainty through a flat rotation curve (R0 = 8.3 kpc, Θ0 = 239 km/s, their adopted set). W_HII = U/100 from the excitation parameter U8.3; 0.1 where no radio flux gives U.
